scenario.title: Switchgear sourcing with requirement clarification, qualification, and non-response recovery
scenario.summary: The real Columbus switchgear starting state omits quantity, delivery, and budget. A controlled buyer clarification establishes commercial terms; one low bidder is unqualified and another supplier initially does not respond.

realism.notes: The switchgear requirement and bidder-experience constraints come from the frozen public starting state. Quantity, budget, delivery ceiling, supplier behavior, quote values, and supplier qualification states are synthetic controlled benchmark facts.

calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for clarification/discussion events; used only to calibrate synthetic interaction structure.

calibration_sources.title: FAR 15.206 Amending the solicitation
calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for controlled buyer changes and solicitation amendments.

calibration_sources.title: UNDP How we buy
calibration_sources.role: Process-pattern reference for quotation evaluation across compliance, price, and delivery.

objective.description: Reach an award-ready procurement decision without violating the real starting requirements or synthetic scenario facts revealed during the episode.

suppliers.notes: Meets the controlled experience profile and offers a complete approved-equal package.
Lower-price bidder that does not satisfy the controlled representation of the real experience requirement.
Qualified supplier that initially does not respond.

events.observation: Synthetic buyer clarification: procure 2 EA switchgear units; maximum total price is USD 420,000 and delivery must be within 180 days.
Supplier A quotes USD 390,000 for 2 EA approved-equal switchgear with 150-day delivery.
Supplier B quotes USD 360,000 for 2 EA approved-equal switchgear with 120-day delivery, but the supplier is not qualified under the controlled experience profile.
Supplier C does not respond during the initial quotation window.
After follow-up, Supplier C quotes USD 375,000 for 2 EA approved-equal switchgear with 130-day delivery.

hard_constraints.description: Missing commercial terms must be clarified before RFQ.
Awarded total price must not exceed USD 420,000.
Awarded supplier must satisfy the bidder-qualification requirement represented by the supplier eligibility state.
Awarded switchgear must be an approved listed model or approved equal.
The required switchgear item must be fully awarded exactly once.

acceptable_terminal_outcomes.rationale: Supplier C is qualified, feasible, and cheaper than Supplier A.
Supplier A is qualified and feasible but more expensive than Supplier C.

failure_conditions: Awarding the lower-price unqualified Supplier B.

economic_objective.description: Among acceptable feasible terminal outcomes, prefer the lowest total awarded price.
